verdict.rationale: Rootly documents Workflows as its automation engine, with triggers, run conditions and actions. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review, or rollback for those workflows. Previewing AI retrospective templates against a past incident is an adjacent, different feature. The API changelog covers Rootly's own API versions, not user automations, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
